name: code2flow-map-codebase
title_zh: Next.js 仓库直接长出可交互的用户流程图
tagline_zh: 产品经理问“用户怎么走”时，不用再翻代码。一条命令从路由到页面全链路生成 Code2Flow 画布，端口固定。
tagline_en: When a PM asks how users move through the app, stop digging through code. One command turns routes into a flow.
desc_en: Map a Next.js App Router repo into a Code2Flow user-flow canvas end to end (init → run → read the summary → report), respecting the fixed localhost port and leaving no server running. Use when a PO or teammate asks "show me the flows / screens / how users move through this app", when a PRD needs checking against code, or before writing user stories for an existing product.
why_zh: 它把“读代码”变成“看图说话”：自动识别 App Router 结构并映射为流程节点。
why_en: It turns code-reading into diagram-reading: auto-detects App Router structure, maps it to flow nodes, and handles port binding.
limit_zh: 只认 Next.js App Router 项目，且本机需已装 Code2Flow CLI。
limit_en: Next.js App Router only; requires Code2Flow CLI installed locally. Output is a canvas file—no screenshots or recordings. Parallel/intercepting.
title_en: Next.js repo to interactive user-flow canvas
